steps.content: You leave the deserted place and make for the red light in the distance. You glance up at the Illusory Moon, feeling sure that she is waiting for you under the moon.

The red moon grows in size as you draw nearer. It is not just your physical body that is approaching it, but your consciousness as well. You stare at it, your eyes boring into it, as your consciousness disintegrates and regroups.
